title: Stocks Slip Before the Open on AI Spending Worries and Higher Bond Yields
excerpt: September S&P 500 E-Mini futures (ESU26) are down -0.42%, and September Nasdaq 100 E-Mini futures (NQU26) are down -0.51% this morning as earnings from Alpha...
content_html:
Oleksandr Pylypenko

Thu, July 23, 2026 at 5:38 AM CDT 9 min read

September S&P 500 E-Mini futures (ESU26) are down -0.42%, and September Nasdaq 100 E-Mini futures (NQU26) are down -0.51% this morning as earnings from Alphabet and Tesla heightened concerns over the scale of AI spending, while rising oil prices drove bond yields higher.

Alphabet (GOOGL) fell nearly -4% in pre-market trading after the Google parent raised its full-year capital spending guidance to as much as $205 billion, overshadowing its stronger-than-expected Q2 results. Notably, Alphabet's quarterly cash flow turned negative for the first time since the company went public more than two decades ago, underscoring the magnitude of its capital spending. Also, Tesla (TSLA) slumped more than -5% in pre-market trading after the EV maker reported weaker-than-expected Q2 adjusted EPS, with a surge in spending leading to its first cash burn in two years.

Adding to the negative sentiment, the price of WTI crude surged over +4% on Thursday after American forces struck Iran for a 12th straight day, while Houthi militants said they had attacked two Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea. The U.K. Maritime Trade Operations confirmed one of the attacks. Meanwhile, The Wall Street Journal reported that the U.S. is building up forces in the Middle East to expand President Trump's military options. 

Treasuries fell across the curve on Thursday as higher oil prices fueled inflation concerns. The 10-year T-note yield rose three basis points to 4.70%.

Investors are now awaiting U.S. jobless claims data and a new round of corporate earnings reports, with a particular focus on results from chipmaker Intel.

In yesterday's trading session, Wall Street's three main equity benchmarks ended in the red. Most members of the Magnificent Seven slid, with Meta Platforms (META) dropping over -2% and Microsoft (MSFT) falling more than -1%. Also, software stocks sank, with Workday (WDAY) and Palantir Technologies (PLTR) sliding over -6%. In addition, GE Vernova (GEV) slumped over -8% and was the top percentage loser on the S&P 500 after the maker of power generation equipment reported weaker-than-expected Q2 adjusted EBITDA. On the bullish side, Super Micro Computer (SMCI) jumped over +19% and was the top percentage gainer on the S&P 500 after the AI server maker doubled its previous FQ4 gross margin guidance.

9 月标准普尔 500 E-Mini 期货 (ESU26) 下跌 -0.42%，9 月纳斯达克 100 E-Mini 期货 (NQU26) 今天上午下跌 -0.51%，原因是 Alphabet 和特斯拉的财报加剧了人们对人工智能支出规模的担忧，而油价上涨推高了债券收益率。

在谷歌母公司将全年资本支出指引提高至高达 2050 亿美元后，Alphabet (GOOGL) 在盘前交易中下跌近-4%，掩盖了其强于预期的第二季度业绩。 值得注意的是，Alphabet 的季度现金流自该公司二十多年前上市以来首次出现负值，凸显了其资本支出的规模。 此外，电动汽车制造商特斯拉(TSLA)报告第二季度调整后每股收益弱于预期，支出激增导致两年来首次烧钱，该公司在盘前交易中下跌超过-5%。

美军连续第 12 天袭击伊朗后，周四 WTI 原油价格飙升超过 4%，而胡塞武装分子表示他们在红海袭击了两艘沙特油轮，这加剧了负面情绪。 英国海事贸易部门证实了其中一起袭击事件。 与此同时，《华尔街日报》报道称，美国正在中东增兵，以扩大特朗普总统的军事选择。

由于油价上涨加剧了通胀担忧，周四国债全线下跌。 10年期国债收益率上升3个基点至4.70%。

投资者目前正在等待美国初请失业金数据和新一轮企业盈利报告，特别关注芯片制造商英特尔的业绩。

在昨天的交易时段，华尔街三大股指均收跌。 七大巨头的大多数成员均出现下滑，元平台 (META) 跌幅超过 -2%，微软 (MSFT) 跌幅超过 -1%。 此外，软件股下跌，Workday (WDAY) 和 Palantir Technologies (PLTR) 跌幅超过 -6%。 此外，发电设备制造商 GE Vernova (GEV) 公布第二季度调整后 EBITDA 弱于预期，股价下跌超过 -8%，成为标准普尔 500 指数跌幅最大的股票。 从看涨的角度来看，人工智能服务器制造商超微电脑 (SMCI) 将其之前的第四季度毛利率指导提高了一倍，其股价跃升超过 19%，成为标准普尔 500 指数中涨幅最大的股票。
